newsitem.title: UK: Safety experts okay Channel Tunnel freight trains.
newsitem.headline: Safety experts okay Channel Tunnel freight trains.

text.p: Channel Tunnel safety experts on Wednesday approved the resumption of freight train services between France and Britain following a fire in the tunnel, Britain's Press Association news agency said.
Earlier Eurotunnel Plc said freight trains might start running through the tunnel within hours after the fire on a lorry in the tunnel on Monday halted services.
Safety experts meeting in Calais postponed a decision on the restoration of full operations involving passenger, private car and lorry trains.
The fire started on a train about 18 kms (11 miles) from the French side. About 70 French and British fire-fighters fought all night to control it.

Fire officers have criticised the design of the rail freight transporters used to carry loaded trucks through the tunnel, focussing on their lattice-work construction, which they say is less safe than a closed wagon.
